title: vibedata-official theme
description: One theme file under themes/. It carries the design system's colour roles and the scheme they belong to. The exact role set and the readability bar (text 4.5:1, control border / focus / line 3:1) are owned by the design system's theme contract and enforced by its scripts/check_theme.py, which runs over these files in CI: this schema checks the file's shape, not the contract.

id.description: Stable identifier, matching the file name without .json. Studio stores a user's pick under this id.

name.description: The theme's own name, as the picker shows it.

scheme.description: The one scheme this theme is. A picker for a scheme lists only its own.

source.description: The upstream the values were converted from.

changes.description: Every correction made to the original values to pass the contract, one human-readable line each. Empty when the original passed unchanged.

roles.description: The design system's colour roles, keyed by token name, with literal colour values. A theme must supply every role the contract requires; the contract itself lives in the design system, not here.
